{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once
# The highest sample_seq (2) supersedes earlier ones
df_dedup = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Correct batch-B values: convert from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Compute mean biomarker_final in ng/mL
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Verify that no row has biomarker_final == -999 (though not required for this question, but good hygiene)
assert df_dedup['biomarker_final'].eq(-999).sum() == 0, "Some biomarker_final values are -999, which is invalid"

# Final report
print(f"Deduplicated patient count: {df_dedup.shape[0]}")
print(f"Corrected mean biomarker_final: {mean_biomarker_final:.2f} ng/mL")"}
